tools.name: tdev_find
tools.description: Find retained work by project name and task label before starting new work. Returns completed predecessors and running/unknown receipts without reconciling effects. Ambiguous or incomplete results never choose a task. Observe original outstanding receipts; do not replay them with new identities.

project.description: Exact enrolled project key or display name; duplicate names are not auto-selected.

label.description: Case-insensitive substring of retained task label.

state.description: Includes closed work by default so completed predecessors are not mistaken for missing work.

tools.name: tdev_workspace
tools.description: Compose enrolled projects without granting access. Inspect membership and current work; revision-CAS changes update only this workspace. Closing preserves tasks, receipts and resources.

tools.name: tdev_task
tools.description: Manage isolated source work. Find existing work with tdev_find before starting again. start creates independent work; fromTaskId creates new work from a published predecessor, not a resume. Inspect returns checkpoint, operations and owned cleanup. Closing does not stop processes or clean resources.

localChanges.description: Capture the enrolled checkout final working-tree bytes into a new task; preserve its index/files/refs. Requires a matching checked-out source branch.
Capture the enrolled checkout final working-tree bytes into a new task; preserve its index/files/refs. Requires a matching checked-out source branch.

tools.name: tdev_read
tools.description: Read files, search, diffs and history from a task checkpoint in one bounded batch. Omitted checkpoint resolves the current committed task source; use returned checkpoint for edits.

tools.name: tdev_edit
tools.description: Atomically edit exact task source with checkpoint and file preconditions. Returns the retained effect receipt and new checkpoint.

tools.name: tdev_exec
tools.description: Run natively on Termux at an exact task checkpoint. command is finite and may capture changes; process persists without capture or a default deadline. Admission is not command success. Observe the retained operation, then cancel/retire explicitly. No shell detachment or provider credentials needed.

waitMs.description: Bounded observation after admission; 0 returns the receipt immediately. Not part of effect identity. Staged stdin requires immediate admission.

mode.description: Finite command; stopped changes may be captured. Default mode.

environment.description: Default task reuses the task's private dependency/cache storage; fresh uses only this operation. HOME and source remain per-operation.

mode.description: Persistent fixed-source process. No capture or admission wait; no default deadline.

environment.description: Default task reuses the task's private dependency/cache storage; fresh uses only this operation. HOME and source remain per-operation.

tools.name: tdev_operation
tools.description: Observe or control an original accepted operation. status by operationId or original lookupRequestId reconciles retained work, including journaled deployment restoration; it never admits a replacement effect. Check terminal result/exitCode. stdin is sequenced; cancel stops execution; retire removes stopped owned scratch while preserving receipts. Never retry ambiguous effects with a new requestId.

waitMs.description: Bounded terminal observation of the original operation; 0 returns immediately. Waiting never creates a new effect. A positive wait may return nonterminal state.
Bounded terminal observation of the original operation; 0 returns immediately. Waiting never creates a new effect. A positive wait may return nonterminal state.

tools.name: tdev_validate
tools.description: Validate exact source into an immutable publication candidate, or validate a retained artifact. Source tests, artifact validation and deployment health are distinct. Check terminal success before using the validation identity. Does not publish or deploy.

environment.description: Default task reuses the task's private dependency/cache storage; fresh uses only this operation. HOME and source remain per-operation.

timeout.description: Validation deadline in seconds; default 300. Increase for a longer adopted test suite, up to 3600.

waitMs.description: Bounded terminal observation of the original operation; 0 returns immediately. Waiting never creates a new effect. A positive wait may return nonterminal state.

health.description: Readiness requires HTTP 200 from 127.0.0.1:port/path with X-Tdev-Release equal to the process TDEV_RELEASE environment value.

timeout.description: Validation deadline in seconds; default 300. Increase for a longer adopted test suite, up to 3600.

tools.name: tdev_publish
tools.description: Publish exactly a successful source-validation candidate using remote-head CAS. Publication is not deployment. If the reply is lost, observe the original request; never send a replacement mutation.

tools.name: tdev_project
tools.description: List, inspect, connect or create enrolled projects within delegated policy. Use existing enrollments when available. The controller selects provider credentials; workspace membership never grants project authority.

tools.name: tdev_deploy
tools.description: Release validated source or artifact to an owned native service. expectedRevision 0 creates; a positive revision updates exactly the inspected service. Inspect live release identity/health separately from acceptance. Rollback uses retained previous bytes. remove preserves data; source publication is independent.

expectedRevision.description: 0 creates a new service only. A positive value updates exactly that inspected revision. Never infer an update from a matching service name.

command.description: Foreground command in the exact source release; use TDEV_DATA_DIR for persistent writable data. Task venv/cache and build outputs are not packaged.

health.description: Readiness requires HTTP 200 from 127.0.0.1:port/path with X-Tdev-Release equal to the process TDEV_RELEASE environment value.

expectedRevision.description: 0 creates a new service only. A positive value updates exactly that inspected revision. Never infer an update from a matching service name.

health.description: Readiness requires HTTP 200 from 127.0.0.1:port/path with X-Tdev-Release equal to the process TDEV_RELEASE environment value.

tools.name: tdev_artifact
tools.description: Inspect recipes, build from exact validated source, and inspect/export retained bytes. Build success is not artifact validation. usage/prunePreview expose retention and pins; prune requires its exact preview identity. Source scratch can retire without deleting retained artifacts.

path.description: Canonical relative path; no traversal, backslashes, control characters or .git components. Additional path/overlap checks are enforced by the controller.

tools.name: tdev_diagnostics
tools.description: Operator-granted diagnostics and optional caller witnesses. Inspect does not activate tracing. Diagnostic failure never justifies repeating development effects. Witness receipts are caller assertions, not proof of host scheduling or visible UI delivery.

oneOf.description: Optional caller witness with increasing per-run sequence. Exact retained replay returns its original receipt; conflicts or expired identity fail. No host/UI attestation; failure never retries development work.
